audit: NCCP early-breast Phesgo retrospective source and software audit
status: Research and proposed corrections only; parent performs integration. Independent clinical and oncology-pharmacy sign-off remains pending.
scope: Live official NCCP 00789 v3 and 00790 v3 PDFs
Actual protocol JSON assessed using js/assessment-engine.js
Patient knowledge JSON, longitudinal journeys, phase-support JSON, generated HTML guide/knowledge/consent/passport/support surfaces

baseline.note: Several cases exercise the same context defect across both cards, and some require explicit clarification rather than correcting a numeric dose. This is not 48 separate clinical dosing errors.

findings.finding: A historical baseline LVEF below initiation criteria creates a new hold during an ongoing assessment even with a normal current result. Conversely, selecting before-starting and entering only current LVEF misses the initiation threshold. A decline without current LVEF lacks an explicit clarification.

Unknown assessment-stage and phase values are accepted by the shared engine. Scoped protocol guards now require correction; invalid TRAIN-2 Day15 is also guarded. Independent severe cardiac and reaction actions remain dominant.
findings.note: These are software guardrails inferred from the source distinctions, not direct NCCP rule wording. No shared engine changes proposed.

findings.finding: The existing selector only acted on grade4. Current grades1–3 and significant injection reactions now pause/stop and prompt assessment, without incorrectly making every reaction a permanent stop. Existing grade4/bronchospasm/ARDS permanent-stop rules remain dominant.
findings.note: Shared proposals harmonised with advanced Phesgo audit; current-reaction input label prevents confusion with resolved history.

findings.finding: Estimated GFR60 without a creatinine timestamp returns proceed_with_caution. Entering stale creatinine or a reference rise without method lacks a specific clarification. Proposed context rules do not invent doses.
Selecting continuation alone returns proceed_with_caution despite no defined postoperative administration. Require the separately selected source regimen; no automatic metastatic00785 routing.
Grade2 neuropathy with no stage fails to explain the starting-treatment exclusion versus different ongoing modification threshold.

The bilirubin-delay rule affects chemotherapy components only although the source coordinates companion drugs while docetaxel is delayed. Proposed action includes the companion antibodies. After chemotherapy is stopped for non-recovery, HER2 continuation remains an individual review.
Explicit age≥18 eligibility was represented only by the aggregate indication flag. Optional age input and under18 specialist-review branch allow direct assessment.
Week12/cycle5 first echo was rendered in the surgery/pathology column rather than during six neoadjuvant cycles. Move this cell; keep elapsed-time scheduling through phase/route changes.

Postoperative blood cells repeat the neoadjuvant schedule, including TRAIN-2 Day8. Follow the chosen postoperative medicine instead. Minimal-risk antibody support must not imply that an unknown HER2-directed ADC has the same supportive needs. Correct the TRAIN-2 continuation citation currently pointing to its count table.
findings.source: Both sources p1; regimen-specific testing/support sections and NCIS antiemetic Table1

findings.finding: Patient-facing chapters contain internal routing language about metastatic regimen00785. Replace with plain language about pathology selecting the next medicine. Week12 imaging column should not imply a universal scheduled response scan because NCCP leaves disease monitoring to the consultant plan.

confirmed_without_threshold_change: Six21-day neoadjuvant cycles; TRAIN-2 paclitaxel Days1/8 and no planned Day15.
SC combined product, loading/reloading1200/600mg8minutes with30minutes observation, maintenance600/600mg5minutes with15minutes observation; finish observation before chemotherapy.
Six-week missed-dose/switch boundary; no percentage reduction of Phesgo.
Baseline cardiac assessment,12-week surveillance and earlier4–8-week checks when impaired; ongoing early-breast cardiac criterion requires both LVEF<50 and decline≥10points.

Existing TCHP printed haematology boundary gaps, hepatic AND/OR ambiguities and TRAIN-2 toxicity overlaps are explicitly referred for review rather than silently rounded or assigned unsupported numeric doses.
Carboplatin GFR≤20 exclusion,20–30caution,<60myelosuppression risk,125cap;48-hour estimated-creatinine rule and110%isotope-reference boundary.

Day1 carboplatin support uses the NCIS high-risk carboplatin row; TRAIN-2 Day8 uses low-risk support. Steroid-reconciliation text is present. Docetaxel and paclitaxel premedication schedules match source-specific sections.
Patient chronology does not require calendar dates; formulation evidence is distinguished from regimen efficacy; no numeric survival metrics are present in patient evidence fields.
limitations: Live official PDFs were browsed; direct binary download returned403, so old source hashes are recorded only as prior-audit provenance and are not freshly verified.
This bounded audit did not separately re-reconcile the entire current NCCP website catalogue.
This is not an exhaustive clinical audit of all possible multi-variable combinations, a prescription, or independent human clinical/pharmacy sign-off.
Parent is responsible for integrating proposals, regenerating outputs, and testing final rendered assets.

integrated_protocol_tests.note: Parent integrated proposals and ran default cases against actual app protocols; final-results.json checked by auditor.
